findings.basis: Signing-time role validity is not established by removal of archival TODO; new text acknowledges long-term evidence loss.
findings.retest: Demonstrate interoperable role credential as-of evidence with revoked-after-signing and missing-historical-evidence cases.

findings.basis: New normative text documents OOBI, QVI and KEL/TEL availability limitations; archive paths are alternatives without retention commitment.
findings.retest: Demonstrate portable historical KEL/TEL reconstruction after issuer and witnesses become unavailable.

findings.basis: Distinct vLEI and X.509 trust/temporal mechanisms remain; common result semantics and cross-lane equivalence are unproven.
findings.retest: Demonstrate lane-preserving result codes for missing revocation evidence and conflicting trust results.

findings.basis: Multiple OOBI URL attempts extend resolver attack exposure; no network-resource-limit proof or real KEL verification run.
findings.retest: Use an isolated verifier to test private-address/redirect/resource limits and witness failover.

findings.basis: The new trust model describes conflicting KEL histories and superseding recovery; no executable branch-history fixtures proving rejection.
findings.retest: Use conflicting KEL/TEL histories, recovery events and stale cache inputs against independent implementations.

combined.conclusion: Archival continuity, distinct authority decisions and adversarial resolution remain linked risks. Source-level assurance review is complete but no implementation-facing conformance or evidence of deployed controls is established.

evidence.source_review_scope: document inspection, static model tests, scenario mapping
evidence.note: Do not present source-level or decision-model checks as KERI, ACDC, COSE, C2PA or X.509 conformance.
